discussion_comments.comment_body: @amy-rich I'm not fully familiar with how AAC does things these days, but is the creation of a service group also part of this quickstart sample? If not then this will most likely not work, right? A Service Group ID is also not a unique string it's a resource path like `/providers/Microsoft.Management/serviceGroups/abcd`. Might make sense to make this a prerequisite and let the user insert a valid service group id here.
yeah those valules shouldn't be generated. They need to be user-supplied. I think the template already works like that. just remove the GEN-UNIQUE
Shouldn't we be using `variables('cloud').graph` which means we don't need this param?

think you can write this to avoid hard coding

```suggestion
            "location": "[resourceGroup().location]",
```

I don't think we want to change this behavior from `GEN-UNIQUE` which will generate a unique value for this `dnsLabelPrefix` value. Otherwise, this template won't work for others once the dns label is taken.
is this location required?  if not remove it and use the defaultValue - if so add allowedValues to the parameter
ADT is not available in the westus location, which the verification gate seems to be using by default. I'm adding it back. Let me know if this isn't the way to handle this issue.

If it's not globally available now - is it planned?  If it's not going to be globally available, we should add allowedValues to the parameter definition.  If it's just "not yet" then adding the param value as you have it all that's needed.
It's unclear when it will be available. I have added @allowedValues to the parameter for location in the digitaltwins module. Are you suggesting to add it into the main.bicep file instead?
use the environment() function for the endpoint...
